# 13 — The record schema

*Written by the suite from [`tests/records/test_record_schema.gd`](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

The shape test from RECORD_SCHEMA.md §5.

Every fixture in tests/fixtures/records/ must be a well-formed schema v1
Stroke Record. This is the only record test that can exist at M0, because
there is no simulation yet to replay anything against; M1 adds the replay
test that checks each fixture reproduces its stored after.hash.

It matters now anyway. Schema v1 freezes at the M1 exit gate, and everything
after that -- forks, Spot Duel, Postal Round, Match -- is an exchange of
these files. A field that quietly changes shape before the freeze takes the
whole fixture set with it.

## What the suite asserts

- [There is at least one fixture](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L59)
- [Fixtures carry the required top level fields](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L69)
- [Fixtures declare schema version one](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L78)
- [Intent is within its declared ranges](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L89)
- [Before state is restorable](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L111)
- [After is present and hashed](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L144)
- [Extensions live in ext](../tests/records/test_record_schema.gd#L161)
